rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for something meant to last forever or indefinitely.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 hai6 wing5 gau2 jau5 haau6

rows.note: Use this for an eternal or timeless quality, especially in abstract, emotional, or philosophical contexts.

example.jyutping: zan1 oi3 ho2 ji5 wing5 hang4

rows.note: Use this for an ongoing state, condition, or arrangement that continues for a very long or indefinite period, rather than necessarily forever.

example.english: We will rent this shop on a permanent basis.
example.traditional: 我哋會長期租用呢個舖位。
